itens.titulo: Itaú Unibanco oferece 15 mil bolsas para bootcamp de Java com IA
itens.descricao: Itaú Unibanco oferece 15 mil bolsas para bootcamp de Java com IA Valor Econômico
trechos: A formação tem 45 horas de conteúdo, distribuídas em 22 cursos, dois desafios de código, dois desafios de projeto e quatro mentorias ao vivo com especialistas.
Na sequência, os participantes estudam fundamentos de Java, programação orientada a objetos e desenvolvimento web, até chegar ao ecossistema “spring”.
O primeiro trabalha “design patterns” com Java, dos padrões clássicos do GoF à aplicação no “spring framework”.
No projeto final, os participantes desenvolvem uma API com reconhecimento de fala, conectando “spring boot” e IA, e o resultado pode integrar o portfólio profissional.
As inscrições podem ser feitas no site até 11 de outubro.

itens.titulo: Farmácias ampliam queda na bolsa após avanço do Mercado Livre em remédios com receita
itens.descricao: Farmácias ampliam queda na bolsa após avanço do Mercado Livre em remédios com receita Exame
trechos: Às 13h30, RD Saúde caía 1,63%, Pague Menos recuava 0,87% e Panvel perdia 0,49%.
As ações das redes de farmácias ampliam as perdas nesta sexta-feira, 25, um dia após o anúncio do Mercado Livre de que passará a vender medicamentos com receita médica.

Por volta das 13h30, quando o principal índice acionário da B3 registrava ligeira queda e 0,02%, aos 183.986 pontos, a RD Saúde (RADL3) recua 1,63% e está entre as oito únicas ações do Ibovespa no campo negativo.
A Panvel (PNVL3) cai 0,49%, enquanto Pague Menos (PGMN3) perde 0,87% no mesmo horário.
a RD Saúde caiu 5,38%, Pague Menos recuou 8% e Panvel perdeu 4,90%.
A companhia começou nesta sexta-feira a vender medicamentos sob prescrição em São Paulo, incluindo antibióticos e medicamentos da classe GLP-1, como o Ozempic.

Além da venda própria, o Mercado Livre pretende levar farmácias tradicionais para dentro de seu marketplace pelo modelo 3P, no qual os parceiros fazem a venda ao consumidor enquanto utilizam a infraestrutura digital e logística da plataforma.
A RD Saúde, por exemplo, registrou R$ 3,9 bilhões em vendas digitais no segundo trimestre de 2026, equivalentes a 31% da receita de varejo.

itens.titulo: 10-year Treasury yield hit a 19-year high—and some investors see opportunity to buy bonds
itens.descricao: 10-year Treasury yield hit a 19-year high—and some investors see opportunity to buy bonds CNBC
trechos: But 10-year Treasury notes offering the highest yield since that year could be good news for investors looking to buy bonds.
"As the 10-year yield goes up, borrowing costs for mortgages also go up almost in lockstep with it," says Dominic J.
"Things like auto loans are also impacted.

Really, kind of any consumer financing or borrowing rates are pretty closely linked to the 10-year Treasury yield." On the flip side, rising Treasury yields do present an opportunity for bond investors.
"Higher interest rates benefit savers and investors just as much as they're harming spenders," Pappalardo says.
"Because of that, there's potentially a really strong opportunity to lock in very attractive levels," says Steve Laipply, global co-head of iShares Fixed Income ETFs for BlackRock.
"We refer to it as a generational income opportunity." Financial and investing professionals caution against making any major money moves based on short-term market conditions.
Additionally, "investors should have an idea of their time horizon," Laipply says.

itens.titulo: Amazon Wouldn’t Be Doing What It’s Doing if AI Capex Was Going to Fail
itens.descricao: Amazon Wouldn’t Be Doing What It’s Doing if AI Capex Was Going to Fail finance.yahoo.com
trechos: Quick Read -       Amazon's AWS backlog hit $496B growing triple digits YoY, with 2027 capacity largely reserved and management committing ~$200B in 2026 capex against real contracts.
-       AWS grew 37%, its fastest pace in 18 quarters, achieving a 39% operating margin, with Anthropic and OpenAI already committing gigawatts of future capacity.
Graviton is now used by 98% of top EC2 customers.

When a management team with a two-decade record of long-duration bets tells shareholders it plans to spend about $200 billion in capital expenditures across 2026, that reflects a company reading its own order book and building against it.
AWS backlog sat at $496 billion, growing triple digits year over year, on a segment already running at a $169 billion annualized revenue run rate.
Andy Jassy told investors the lion's share of AWS capacity planned for 2027 is largely reserved, with "quite a bit of capacity" already reserved for 2028.

Jassy walked through it plainly: data centers have 30-plus year useful lives, servers break even in a little less than three years and then run for at least five to six years, with most AI capacity contracted for at least five-year terms.
Numbers That Earned My Conviction Q2 FY2026 gave me three receipts.

itens.titulo: Tesla's Semi Is Finally Moving Into a Bigger Test
itens.descricao: Tesla's Semi Is Finally Moving Into a Bigger Test Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with TSLA.
Tesla reiterated plans to build up to 50,000 Semis annually at its plant in Sparks, Nevada, although it did not provide a timeline for reaching that level or disclose current production volumes.
Tesla says the long-range version of the Semi can travel 500 miles on a charge while fully loaded.
A standard version offers 325 miles.
The next catalyst is Tesla's production ramp in Nevada and evidence of how quickly it can move toward its 50,000-truck annual capacity target.

itens.titulo: Bank of America Cuts 2027 Luxury Forecast as Q3 Demand Growth Slows
itens.descricao: Bank of America Cuts 2027 Luxury Forecast as Q3 Demand Growth Slows finance.yahoo.com
trechos: Bank of America has reduced its 2027 forecast for the global luxury sector after industry data tracked by the bank indicated that demand growth slowed during the third quarter to date compared with the previous three months.
According to the bank, global luxury demand decelerated by between 2 and 3 percentage points in the third quarter to date relative to the second quarter.
Bank of America Forecasts 4% Q3 Luxury Revenue Growth Bank of America currently models luxury-sector revenue growth of 4% for the third quarter of 2026.
That would represent a slowdown of 3 percentage points from the second quarter, against a year-earlier comparison that the bank said is 6 percentage points more demanding.
For 2027, the bank recently reduced its forecast and now expects overall luxury revenue to increase by 4%.
Within the sector, Bank of America forecasts 3% revenue growth for soft luxury and 6% growth for hard luxury.

Luxury Sector Valuation at Lower End of Recent Range Bank of America said the luxury sector is trading at approximately 20 times earnings, placing its price-to-earnings multiple at the lower end of the 20-to-25-times range cited by the bank.

The analysis is based on industry data monitored by Bank of America, while its third-quarter and 2027 figures remain forecasts and are subject to changes in consumer demand and broader market conditions.
